description: Deterministic floor policy for the isolated PR Attention Router POC.

pathRules.rationale: If CI or attention automation breaks unnoticed, unvalidated changes can pass or pull requests can be misclassified.
If floor enforcement or notification code breaks unnoticed, every classified pull request can receive an unsafe result.
If repository policy or host context breaks unnoticed, every pull request can receive the wrong deterministic floor or AI context.
If operational guidance breaks unnoticed, adopters or responders can configure or operate the router incorrectly.
If PR context configuration breaks unnoticed, reviewers can lose the intent evidence needed for a safe LOW result.
If the dashboard shell or shared model breaks unnoticed, every dashboard tier or queue can display incorrect information.
If build or dependency configuration breaks unnoticed, validation or the production dashboard can diverge for all consumers.
If repository instructions break unnoticed, every coding agent can operate under the wrong safety or workflow contract.
